title: 第一卷 第23章 白辞拿捏第一卷 第24章 一阶炼丹师
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: “合作？”白辞冷笑一声，语气嘲弄，“你有什么资格和我合作？”
正如曹阳所说。
她的目标是这阵法，自然有办法收走。
可她的办法凭什么共享给曹阳？
曹阳也不在乎她的嘲讽，语气依旧平淡，“你想方设法将我带到这里来，不仅仅只是为了对抗枯木妖，其实收走阵法还需要我吧？”
白辞面色变了又变，沉声说道：“是又如何？”
“所以了。”曹阳耸了耸肩，“这就是我们合作的基础。”
“我们没有任何合作基础。”白辞态度依旧强硬，“我大不了再找别人来就行了。”
她的办法确实需要曹阳。
但是现在曹阳已经脱离了掌控，所以她已经打算放弃了。
“是么？”曹阳脸上忽然挂起了笑容。
看着这个笑容，白辞心中忽然有种不好的预感。
果不其然，下一刻，曹阳脚下的地面忽然泛起一层灰黑色的幽光。
紧接着，一股狂暴的煞气凭空凝聚，化作一条粗壮的地刺，瞬间停在白辞的鼻尖前。
只要再往前送半寸，就能贯穿她的脑袋。
白辞瞳孔猛地收缩。
“你……你竟然夺了阵法的控制权？”她声音干涩，带着难以掩饰的骇然。
“不多，一点点而已。”曹阳驱散地刺，拍了拍手，“现在可以合作了吗？”
白辞深吸了一口气，压下心头的震动，眼底的轻蔑彻底收敛。
眼前这个男人，比她想象的还要邪门的多。
他身上，有别人完全无法比拟的优势。
甚至，白辞忽然发现，在这种情况下，自己唯有和曹阳合作了。
因为她走不了了！
现在残阵被曹阳掌控，白辞毫不怀疑自己一旦离开，对方会立刻催动阵法。
“这残阵无法装进储物袋。”白辞认清现实，沉声开口，“唯一的办法，就是以活人肉身作为阵盘，强行将阵纹刻入丹田。”
“嗯？”曹阳神情微愣。
这是什么办法？
白辞看着他那满脸怀疑的表情，轻哼一声，“你在怀疑我的准备吗？”
“不仅是我，我母亲也在生前将对于阵法的研究全部传授于我，不要质疑我们母女的努力。”
“行行行。”曹阳伸手示意，“你继续。”
白辞翻了个白眼，说出了收取残阵的条件。
“第一，阵盘必须是人类修士。”
“第二，这个人类修士还必须拥有五行灵根。”
“第三，神魂强度至少要达到四人魂以上的级别，否则撑不住阵法入体时的煞气冲击。”
曹阳越听，面色越是古怪。
这三点条件他全都符合啊。
看着曹阳古怪的脸色，白辞没有隐瞒，直接摊牌，“你猜得没错，我们找上你，就是因为你这三点全达标，你简直就是为了这个阵法量身定做的容器。”
content_en:
"Cooperation?" Bai Ci sneered in a mocking tone, "What qualifications do you have to cooperate with me?"
As Cao Yang said.
Her goal is this formation, so she naturally has a way to take it away.
But why should she share her method with Cao Yang?
Cao Yang didn't care about her sarcasm, and his tone remained calm, "You tried every means to bring me here, not just to fight against the dead wood demon, but you actually need me to take away the formation, right?"
Bai Ci's expression changed again and again, and he said in a deep voice: "So what?"
"So." Cao Yang shrugged, "This is the basis of our cooperation."
"We don't have any basis for cooperation." Bai Ci's attitude was still tough, "I can just find someone else to do it at the worst."
Her method does require Cao Yang.
But now that Cao Yang was out of control, she was ready to give up.
"Really?" Cao Yang suddenly had a smile on his face.
Looking at this smile, Bai Ci suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
Sure enough, the next moment, the ground under Cao Yang's feet suddenly glowed with a gray-black light.
Immediately afterwards, a violent evil spirit condensed out of thin air and turned into a thick thorn, which instantly stopped in front of Bai Ci's nose.
Just move it forward half an inch and it will penetrate her head.
Bai Ci's pupils shrank suddenly.
"You...you actually took control of the formation?" Her voice was dry, with unconcealable horror.
"Not much, just a little bit." Cao Yang dispersed the thorns and clapped his hands, "Can we cooperate now?"
Bai Ci took a deep breath, suppressing the shock in his heart, and the contempt in his eyes completely subsided.
The man in front of her was much more evil than she imagined.
He has advantages that others cannot match.
In fact, Bai Ci suddenly found that in this situation, he had no choice but to cooperate with Cao Yang.
Because she can't leave!
Now that the remaining formation is under Cao Yang's control, Bai Ci has no doubt that once he leaves, the other party will immediately activate the formation.
"This remnant formation cannot be put into the storage bag." Bai Ci recognized the reality and said in a deep voice, "The only way is to use the body of a living person as the formation disk and forcibly carve the formation patterns into the Dantian."
"Huh?" Cao Yang looked slightly stunned.
What is this?
Bai Ci looked at his suspicious expression and snorted, "Are you doubting my preparation?"
"Not only me, but my mother also taught me all the research on formations during her lifetime. Don't question the efforts of our mother and daughter."
"Okay, okay." Cao Yang stretched out his hand to indicate, "You continue."
Bai Ci rolled his eyes and stated the conditions for collecting the remaining formation.
"First, the array must be a human monk."
"Second, this human monk must also possess the Five Elements Spiritual Root."
"Third, the strength of the soul must reach at least the level of four human souls, otherwise it will not be able to withstand the impact of the evil energy when the formation enters the body."
The more Cao Yang listened, the weirder his expression became.
He meets all three conditions.
Seeing Cao Yang's strange expression, Bai Ci didn't hide anything and directly showed his cards, "You're right, we came to you because you met the standards on these three points. You are simply a container tailor-made for this formation."
